hero.title: Real People. Real Offers.
hero.subtitle: See how coaching transformed their careers and salaries

verifyBanner.text: Every testimonial below is verified on IGotAnOffer. Click to verify.

salaryDisclaimer: Salary estimates based on levels.fyi market data for role and company. Individual results vary based on experience, location, and negotiation.

featuredStories.name: Vaughn
featuredStories.review: THANK YOU RUPESH!!! I landed a role at DraftKings after Rupesh's coaching session. His OOD interview prep was exactly what I needed!
featuredStories.coachReply: Congratulations Vaughn! Your dedication to the OOD prep paid off. Wishing you continued success at DraftKings!

featuredStories.name: Andre
featuredStories.review: I had a prep session with Rupesh for my Amazon interview. His experience as an Amazon Solutions Architect shows in his coaching. Rupesh gave clear feedback on my technical answers and communication style, spotting weaknesses I missed. I recommend Rupesh to anyone preparing for a technical interview.
featuredStories.coachReply: I don't do generic coaching. I focus on what actually works in real Amazon interviews.

featuredStories.name: Omotola
featuredStories.review: Rupesh is patient, thorough, and a confidence-booster. I had an excellent experience learning from him!
featuredStories.coachReply: Omotola landed a Senior Engineer role at Red Hat. Your preparation and dedication made the difference!

featuredStories.name: Karthik
featuredStories.review: Rupesh helped me crack my dream role! His insights on how to approach technical and behavioral rounds were spot-on. I can't recommend him enough for anyone serious about landing a senior tech role.
featuredStories.coachReply: Karthik's dedication to the process was exceptional. Well-deserved offer at a top FAANG company!

featuredStories.name: Melvin
featuredStories.review: Rupesh was amazing to work with. As a beginning Solutions Architect, I was stuck in my career, and he provided guidance for sharpening my skills, demonstrating competence, building my brand. By the end of the session, I had a 90-day step-by-step plan to turn my career around.

featuredStories.name: Shiv
featuredStories.review: I had the opportunity to interview with Rupesh for the Senior Site Reliability Engineer role. The session was very engaging, he created a comfortable environment. His questions focused not only on technical depth but also on collaboration, ownership, and leadership.
featuredStories.coachReply: Glad the session helped you sharpen both the technical and leadership side of your prep. Wishing you the best with Google!

featuredStories.name: Director Success Story
featuredStories.focusArea: Director Interview Prep, Leadership Principles, Executive Presence
featuredStories.review: Rupesh's coaching was transformative for my Director-level interview at AWS. He helped me articulate org-level impact, demonstrate executive presence, and structure my STAR stories to show strategic thinking. His insider knowledge of Amazon's Leadership Principles and bar raiser expectations was invaluable. I got the offer!
featuredStories.coachReply: Director interviews are about scope, impact, and influence - not just technical depth. You nailed it!

featuredStories.name: VP Success Story
featuredStories.focusArea: VP Interview Prep, Organizational Strategy, Cross-functional Leadership
featuredStories.review: Preparing for a VP role at Google required a completely different approach than my previous interviews. Rupesh helped me understand how to demonstrate organizational impact, strategic vision, and the ability to influence without authority. His frameworks for executive communication and stakeholder management were game-changers. Landed the VP role!
featuredStories.coachReply: VP interviews test your ability to think at scale and influence across boundaries. You demonstrated that perfectly.

featuredStories.name: Principal Engineer Success
featuredStories.focusArea: Principal Engineer Interview, System Design at Scale, Technical Leadership
featuredStories.review: Rupesh's system design coaching at the Principal level was exceptional. He helped me think beyond just architecture - about organizational impact, technical strategy, and how to influence engineering culture. His mock interviews were tougher than the real ones, which made the actual interview feel easy. Got the Principal Engineer offer at Microsoft!
featuredStories.coachReply: Principal roles require technical depth AND organizational influence. You showed both beautifully.

additionalStories.name: Ann
additionalStories.review: This was my >2 times with Rupesh for mock interview! He holds a very high bar and treats each mock interview as seriously as if it were his own team's hiring process. The session was incredibly valuable, and I truly believe his guidance will help me ace the interview!
additionalStories.coachReply: Your dedication and progress are inspiring. I'm truly honored to be part of your journey. Wishing you all the best for the final panel!

additionalStories.name: Ca
additionalStories.review: I took multiple sessions with Rupesh and have consistently been impressed by his deep expertise in DevOps and the AWS cloud domain. He is genuinely passionate about his work and goes above and beyond to support his students. I highly recommend him for coaching in Java, DevOps, Cloud (AWS), and SRE domains.

additionalStories.name: Bijan
additionalStories.review: A fantastic call. I learned a huge amount of practical and valuable information. I now have a clear, structured plan towards my interviews.
additionalStories.coachReply: You asked sharp questions and leaned into the frameworks fast. That's why you left with a clear plan. Most people walk into TPM interviews unstructured; you're already fixing that.
